# PLAN — iteration 2

## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 is the verified best at 25 LUTs and 15 FFs, but setup timing remains infeasible at WNS −0.17 ns. The advisor’s registered-`out_valid` trial improved WNS to −0.081 ns, then exposed `in_ready` as the critical path; it did not close timing. The objective remains timing feasibility first, with LUT reduction considered after closure.

## Hypothesis
Register a `has_space` status bit alongside occupancy and drive `in_ready` as `has_space || out_ready`; this may shorten the occupancy-to-pad path while preserving the required combinational dependence on `out_ready`.

## Instruction for generator
In `packet_fifo_core`, retain the accepted `out_valid` register change and add a resettable `has_space` register that tracks whether next occupancy is below `DEPTH`; update it correctly for push-only, pop-only, simultaneous push/pop, and hold cases, including `DEPTH=1`. Drive `in_ready` from `has_space || out_ready` while preserving full simultaneous pop/push, capacity, synchronous reset priority, and all existing transfer behavior. Keep the top’s `// @latency 1` annotation and interface unchanged; do not add pipeline stages.
